mapper.select: SELECT 'ULS001' AS centerCode, COUNT(*) AS requestCount, SUM(CASE WHEN schk = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS waitCount, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN schk = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN CAST(0 AS BIT) ELSE CAST(1 AS BIT) END AS confirmed FROM Hohosc_book_order_add WHERE Yyyy = #{year} AND Mm = #{month} HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

--d_hohosc_order_list_sub_all_total_u
--hohosc_book_order : 주문테이블 --Hohosc_book_order_add : 추가반품테이블 --Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi : 수기주문테이블 --hohosc_office_user : 선생님 테이블 --codezip : 코드 테이블
-- 선생님별 월 주문 집계 -- SELECT CASE A.gb WHEN '0' THEN 'order' WHEN '1' THEN 'add' WHEN '2' THEN 'return' END as rowType, FORMAT( CONVERT(DATETIME, SUBSTRING(idate, 1, 4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(idate, 5, 2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(idate, 7, 2) + ' ' + SUBSTRING(idate, 9, 2) + ':' + SUBSTRING(idate, 11, 2) ), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS orderDate, A.class_name as className, A.unit_name as unitName, CASE WHEN A.gb = 2 THEN -qty ELSE qty end as totalCount, CASE WHEN A.gb = 2 THEN - A.danga ELSE A.danga end as unitPrice, CASE WHEN A.gb = 2 THEN - A.qty ELSE A.qty end * A.danga as totalPrice, userName = (SELECT t.name from hohosc_office_user t Where t.UID = A.teaid) FROM (SELECT A.yyyy, A.mm, A.ggubun, A.mgubun, REPLACE(A.mgubun_str, '월', '호') as unit_name, A.class_name, sum(A.qty) as qty, 0 as tqty, A.idate as idate, '0' as gb, A.teaid, 15000 as danga, '1' as gb_sort FROM (SELECT H.*, class_name = (SELECT C.note FROM codezip C WHERE C.code2 = ggubun), 1 as qty from (select a.* from (select yyyy, mm, teaid, max(idate) as idate from hohosc_book_order h where yyyy = #{year} and mm = #{month} and h.yyyy + h.mm + h.teaid = (SELECT TOP 1 O.yyyy + O.mm+ o.teaid FROM hohosc_book_order O WHERE O.yyyy = h.yyyy and O.mm = h.mm and O.teaid = h.teaid ORDER BY O.yyyy DESC, O.mm DESC, O.idate DESC) group by yyyy, mm, teaid) a where a.yyyy + a.mm + a.idate = (SELECT TOP 1 O.yyyy + O.mm + o.idate FROM hohosc_book_order O WHERE O.yyyy = a.yyyy and O.mm = A.mm and O.idate = a.idate ORDER BY O.yyyy DESC, O.mm DESC, O.idate DESC)) A JOIN hohosc_book_order H ON A.yyyy = H.yyyy AND A.mm = H.mm AND A.idate = H.idate) A GROUP BY yyyy, mm, ggubun, mgubun, mgubun_str, class_name, idate, teaid
UNION ALL
SELECT A.yyyy, A.mm, A.ggubun, A.mgubun, A.unit_name, A.class_name, sum(A.addqty) as qty, sum(A.tqty) as tqty, max(A.idate) as idate, a.gb, a.Teaid, 15000 as danga, '2' as gb_sotrt FROM (SELECT dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add.Yyyy, dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add.Mm, replace(gbcd, ' ', '') as ggubun, replace(dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add.mgubun, ' ', '') as mgubun, dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add.mgubun_note as unit_name, dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add.gbcd_note as class_name, 0 as qty, 0 as tqty, dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add.cnt as addqty, dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add.idate, isnull(dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add.gb, '1') AS gb, Teaid FROM dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add WHERE dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add.Yyyy = #{year} AND dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add.Mm = #{month} AND isnull(dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add.gb, '1') in ('1', '2') AND dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add.schk in ('Y')) A group by substring(idate, 1, 8), A.yyyy, A.mm, A.ggubun, A.mgubun, A.unit_name, A.class_name, a.gb, a.Teaid
UNION ALL
SELECT A.yyyy, A.mm, A.ggubun, A.mgubun, A.unit_name, A.class_name, sum(A.addqty) as qty, sum(A.tqty) as tqty, max(A.idate) as idate, a.gb, a.Teaid, a.danga, '5' as gb_sort FROM (SELECT dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi.Yyyy, dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi.Mm, replace(gbcd, ' ', '') as ggubun, replace(dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi.mgubun, ' ', '') as mgubun, dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi.mgubun_note as unit_name, dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi.gbcd_note as class_name, 0 as qty, 0 as tqty, dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi.cnt as addqty, dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi.idate, isnull(dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi.gb, '1') AS gb, Teaid, dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi.danga FROM dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi WHERE dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi.Yyyy = #{year} AND dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi.Mm = #{month} AND isnull(dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi.gb, '1') in ('1', '2') AND dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi.schk in ('Y')) A group by substring(idate, 1, 8), A.yyyy, A.mm, A.ggubun, A.mgubun, A.unit_name, A.class_name, a.gb, a.Teaid, a.danga) A Order by idate, A.teaid, Case when A.ggubun = 'U1' Then 1 when A.ggubun = 'U2' Then 2 when A.ggubun = 'U3' Then 3 when A.ggubun = 'E1' Then 4 when A.ggubun = 'E2' Then 5 when A.ggubun = 'E3' Then 6 when A.ggubun = 'E4' Then 7 when A.ggubun = 'UA' Then 11 when A.ggubun = 'UB' Then 12 when A.ggubun = 'UC' Then 13 when A.ggubun = 'EA' Then 14 when A.ggubun = 'EB' Then 15 end, A.mgubun;

SELECT idx AS id, CASE WHEN gb = 1 THEN 'ADD' WHEN gb = 2 THEN 'RETURN' END AS state, teaidname AS userName, gbcd_note AS className, REPLACE(mgubun_note, '월', '호') as unitName, cnt AS cnt, CASE schk WHEN 'Y' THEN 'checked' WHEN 'N' THEN 'unchecked' WHEN 'C' THEN 'user_cancel' WHEN 'D' THEN 'acancel' END AS confirmed, 'ULS001' AS centerCode, FORMAT( CONVERT(DATETIME, SUBSTRING(idate, 1, 4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(idate, 5, 2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(idate, 7, 2) + ' ' + SUBSTRING(idate, 9, 2) + ':' + SUBSTRING(idate, 11, 2) ), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS createdAt, note AS reason FROM Hohosc_book_order_add WHERE Yyyy = #{year} AND Mm = #{month}
AND schk = 'N'

SELECT class_name AS className, unit_name AS unitName, SUM(baseCount) AS baseCount, 0 AS teacherCount, SUM(reorderCount) AS reorderCount, SUM(baseCount) + SUM(reorderCount) AS totalCount, 0 AS timeTableCount FROM ( -- 기본 주문 SELECT A.ggubun, A.class_name, A.unit_name, SUM(A.qty) AS baseCount, 0 AS reorderCount FROM (SELECT H.*, class_name = (SELECT C.note FROM codezip C WHERE C.code2 = ggubun), REPLACE(mgubun_str, '월', '호') AS unit_name, 1 AS qty FROM (SELECT a.* FROM (SELECT yyyy, mm, teaid, MAX(idate) AS idate FROM hohosc_book_order h WHERE yyyy = #{year} AND mm = #{month} AND h.yyyy + h.mm + h.teaid = (SELECT TOP 1 O.yyyy + O.mm + O.teaid FROM hohosc_book_order O WHERE O.yyyy = h.yyyy AND O.mm = h.mm AND O.teaid = h.teaid ORDER BY O.yyyy DESC, O.mm DESC, O.idate DESC) GROUP BY yyyy, mm, teaid) a WHERE a.yyyy + a.mm + a.idate = (SELECT TOP 1 O.yyyy + O.mm + O.idate FROM hohosc_book_order O WHERE O.yyyy = a.yyyy AND O.mm = a.mm AND O.idate = a.idate ORDER BY O.yyyy DESC, O.mm DESC, O.idate DESC)) A JOIN hohosc_book_order H ON A.yyyy = H.yyyy AND A.mm = H.mm AND A.idate = H.idate) A GROUP BY A.ggubun, A.class_name, A.unit_name
UNION ALL
-- 추가/반품 SELECT REPLACE(gbcd, ' ', '') AS ggubun, gbcd_note AS class_name, REPLACE(mgubun_note, '월', '호') AS unit_name, 0 AS baseCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(gb, '1') = '2' THEN -cnt ELSE cnt END) AS reorderCount FROM Hohosc_book_order_add WHERE Yyyy = #{year} AND Mm = #{month} AND ISNULL(gb, '1') IN ('1', '2') AND schk = 'Y' GROUP BY REPLACE(gbcd, ' ', ''), gbcd_note, REPLACE(mgubun_note, '월', '호')) AS sub GROUP BY ggubun, class_name, unit_name ORDER BY CASE ggubun WHEN 'U1' THEN 1 WHEN 'U2' THEN 2 WHEN 'U3' THEN 3 WHEN 'E1' THEN 4 WHEN 'E2' THEN 5 WHEN 'E3' THEN 6 WHEN 'E4' THEN 7 WHEN 'UA' THEN 11 WHEN 'UB' THEN 12 WHEN 'UC' THEN 13 WHEN 'EA' THEN 14 WHEN 'EB' THEN 15 END, unit_name

SELECT user_name AS userName, user_code AS userCode, class_name AS className, unit_name AS unitName, SUM(baseCount) AS baseCount, 0 AS teacherCount, SUM(reorderCount) AS reorderCount, SUM(baseCount) + SUM(reorderCount) AS totalCount, 0 AS timeTableCount FROM ( -- 기본 주문 SELECT t.name AS user_name, A.teaid AS user_code, A.ggubun, A.class_name, A.unit_name, SUM(A.qty) AS baseCount, 0 AS reorderCount FROM ( SELECT H.*, class_name = (SELECT C.note FROM codezip C WHERE C.code2 = ggubun), REPLACE(mgubun_str, '월', '호') AS unit_name, 1 AS qty FROM ( SELECT a.* FROM ( SELECT yyyy, mm, teaid, MAX(idate) AS idate FROM hohosc_book_order h WHERE yyyy = #{year} AND mm = #{month} AND h.yyyy + h.mm + h.teaid = ( SELECT TOP 1 O.yyyy + O.mm + O.teaid FROM hohosc_book_order O WHERE O.yyyy = h.yyyy AND O.mm = h.mm AND O.teaid = h.teaid ORDER BY O.yyyy DESC, O.mm DESC, O.idate DESC) GROUP BY yyyy, mm, teaid ) a WHERE a.yyyy + a.mm + a.idate = ( SELECT TOP 1 O.yyyy + O.mm + O.idate FROM hohosc_book_order O WHERE O.yyyy = a.yyyy AND O.mm = a.mm AND O.idate = a.idate ORDER BY O.yyyy DESC, O.mm DESC, O.idate DESC) ) A JOIN hohosc_book_order H ON A.yyyy = H.yyyy AND A.mm = H.mm AND A.idate = H.idate ) A JOIN hohosc_office_user t ON t.UID = A.teaid GROUP BY t.name, A.teaid, A.ggubun, A.class_name, A.unit_name
UNION ALL
-- 추가/반품 SELECT teaidname, Teaid, REPLACE(gbcd, ' ', '') AS ggubun, gbcd_note AS class_name, REPLACE(mgubun_note, '월', '호') AS unit_name, 0 AS baseCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(gb, '1') = '2' THEN -cnt ELSE cnt END) AS reorderCount FROM Hohosc_book_order_add WHERE Yyyy = #{year} AND Mm = #{month} AND ISNULL(gb, '1') IN ('1', '2') AND schk = 'Y' GROUP BY teaidname, Teaid, REPLACE(gbcd, ' ', ''), gbcd_note, REPLACE(mgubun_note, '월', '호') ) AS sub GROUP BY user_name, user_code, ggubun, class_name, unit_name ORDER BY user_name, CASE ggubun WHEN 'U1' THEN 1 WHEN 'U2' THEN 2 WHEN 'U3' THEN 3 WHEN 'E1' THEN 4 WHEN 'E2' THEN 5 WHEN 'E3' THEN 6 WHEN 'E4' THEN 7 WHEN 'UA' THEN 11 WHEN 'UB' THEN 12 WHEN 'UC' THEN 13 WHEN 'EA' THEN 14 WHEN 'EB' THEN 15 END, unit_name
